_comment: Yahoo/yfinance-style export: one file, many tickers in a 'Company' column, timestamped+timezoned dates (the 'iso' format tolerates the trailing time/offset), extra Dividends/Stock Splits columns ignored. Bars must already be adjusted — this tool does NO split/dividend math (SAD#2.2). Names/sectors come from metadata.synthetic.json since the CSV carries none.
